'''Dheeb''' was the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] leading the [[Trandoshan pirates|Trandoshan Pirates]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. His right leg was replaced with a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic limb]]. [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|A Jedi Knight]] defeated him and his two subordinates, [[Grahssk]] and [[Sarkh]] at the [[Trandoshan Pirate's outpost]].
